newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi fund grants Saudi Chevron $136 million loan.
newsitem.headline: Saudi fund grants Saudi Chevron $136 million loan.

text.p: The Saudi Industrial Development Fund (SIDF) said on Wednesday it had granted loans of 510 million riyals ($136 million) to Saudi Chevron Petrochemical (SCP) to help build two petrochemical projects.
The SIDF said one loan for 400 million riyals went towards a 2.1 billion riyal benzene plant with a production capacity of 482,000 tonnes per year.
The second loan of 110 million riyals was for a 227 million riyal cyclohexane unit with a production capacity of 220,000 tonnes per year.
The projects are part of a $650 million petrochemical complex in the Saudi industrial city of Jubail.
On Sunday the Saudi Investment Bank said SCP had signed a $305 million credit facilities deal with a group of financial institutions for the construction and operation of the plant.

SCP is equally owned by Arabian Chevron Petrochemical Company Limited (ACPC), a Bermuda subsidiary of Chevron Corp of the United States and Saudi Industrial Venture Capital Group of Saudi Arabia. ($1=3.75 riyals)
